execution_environment: authorized elevated Nix shell with /proc verified present
method: Compare cwd only with the exact known task checkout; discard all nonmatching information without reading command/stat. Read command/stat metadata only for exact matches.
limits: Exact-checkout process check only; no recovered terminal exit status and no inventory of unrelated host processes.
actions: Read-only; no signals, compiler/checker/hash-helper launch, cache or Git mutation.
